description: This Java source file defines a class 'SchedulerTriggerListener' that implements the Quartz 'TriggerListener' interface. Its purpose is to listen to scheduler trigger events, veto job executions conditionally based on tenant context, and manage tenant context during job execution in a multi-tenant environment within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: SchedulerTriggerListener
classes.description: A trigger listener that manages tenant context and veto logic during Quartz scheduling events within Fineract.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the trigger listener.

methods.name: triggerFired
methods.description: Called when a trigger has fired; logs debug information.

methods.name: vetoJobExecution
methods.description: Determines whether to veto the execution of a job based on tenant context and external veto logic.

methods.name: triggerMisfired
methods.description: Handles misfired triggers; logs an error.

methods.name: triggerComplete
methods.description: Called when a trigger has completed; logs debug information.
